messages:
mira: T-minus ~18h to cutoff. Quick green-check: version bump is merged to release/v2.4? Changelog needs that one-line entry. Starting a focused green sweep now — call out any flakes or infra issues here. @priya can you own flaky triage for the next 2 hours?
jon: bump landed on release/v2.4 yes. changelog has the entry but missing the PR link, will add. One PR (PR#4128) shows CI failing in integration-e2e.
lucy: I see the integration-e2e failure, looks like a timeout in test "session-reconnect". Reproduced locally once. Log: http://ci.internal/4128/logs/integration-e2e
dan: integration-e2e has been noisy since the db-conn change yesterday. Heap OOM in some shards logged in the run. Throwing it to @priya for triage but infra might need a quick config tweak.
priya: On it. I'll start by re-running the failing job and isolating the test. If it's a flaky test we can quarantine and re-run the sweep.
qa-bot: Automated re-run triggered for job integration-e2e (build 9876) by @priya. Results expected in ~6m.
priya: re-run finished — still failing same test 1/3 runs. I'm going to bisect the test to see if it's timing-dependent. Also will open a quarantine flag if we confirm flake.
mira: Hold all merges to release/v2.4 until we resolve the integration-e2e blocker. No further auto-merges. If you need a hotfix, do a targeted cherry-pick PR and ping here.
jon: ack. I'll hold my change queue. If we need hotfix, plan is: git checkout release/v2.4 && git cherry-pick <sha> && git push origin release/v2.4:refs/heads/release-hotfix-4128
deploy-bot: Green sweep progress: 12/13 jobs passed. integration-e2e (job 9876) failed. See job: http://ci.internal/9876
lucy: dug in — the failing assertion depends on auth token expiry around 30s in this env; test uses a mocked token but timing edge exists. I've opened issue ENG-3112 and a small test-fix PR draft.
priya: If it's just timing, we can quarantine the test from the sweep to get the release out and patch the test right after. Do we have consensus to quarantine?
mira: Yes — quarantine the test for this sweep only. @lucy open the quarantine ticket and mark test as flaky in the test registry, then submit the test-fix PR and link it here. Once green sweep completes, we'll unblock merges and do a small hotfix if needed. :thumbsup:
jon: quarantine done, flagged ENG-3112-quarantine and skipped the test in the pipeline for this run. Kicking off a new sweep.
qa-bot: New sweep triggered: 13/13 jobs now running (with quarantined test skipped). ETA ~8m.
deploy-bot: Sweep completed: 13/13 jobs passed. Release/v2.4 is green for cutoff.
mira: Excellent — thanks team. Keep changelog PR with the link to PR#4128 and the hotfix note. Post-mortem for the flake in ENG-3112 please. I'll open the release ticket and schedule final cutover at t-minus 4h.
